generation_budget.deduplication: exact text_sha256 within a run and across runs; first occurrence wins
generation_budget.split_rule: sha256(text)[:2] parity — content-addressed, computed before inspection
generation_budget.unlabelled_policy: texts with no cached scorer verdict are counted and are in neither pool. Treating them as clean would understate the false-alarm rate.
generation_budget.why_a_budget_is_part_of_the_freeze: seeds fix WHICH trajectories are drawn; the budget fixes HOW MANY. A bank whose size is decided at generation time can be grown until a gate passes, and nothing in the artifact would show it. FINAL_GATE_BANK_MANIFEST.json froze the seeds and the minimum label counts and not this, which is the gap these commands close.

sealed_until: the human validation frozen in DETECTOR_V4_2_LLM_JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 10 passes, the checkpoint and threshold are frozen, and publication_label_valid is true. A model-judge-authorised run opens the ENGINEERING bank instead.
why_a_separate_file: FINAL_GATE_BANK_MANIFEST.json is frozen pre-registration and is not edited, for the same reason DETECTOR_V4_ORACLE_CEILING.json is not edited. This file sits beside it, carries its hash, and adds only what it did not fix.
